connection_failed.pattern: (connection refused|cannot connect|failed to connect|unable to connect|connection timed out)
connection_failed.title: Connection Failed
connection_failed.description: Unable to establish connection with the Android TV device
solutions: Verify the IP address is correct and the device is on the same network
Enable USB debugging in Developer Options on your Android TV
Enable Network debugging (ADB over network) in Developer Options
Check if port 5555 is open on the device (firewall/router settings)
Try restarting ADB server: disconnect, then reconnect

installation_failed.title: Installation Failed
solutions: Enable 'Install from Unknown Sources' in device settings
Check if there is enough storage space on the device
Verify the APK file is not corrupted (try re-downloading)
Uninstall the existing version first if upgrading
Check if the APK is compatible with your device architecture (ARM/x86)

permission_denied.title: Permission Denied
permission_denied.description: Insufficient permissions to perform the operation
solutions: Ensure USB debugging is enabled on the device
Check if ADB has proper authorization (accept prompt on TV)
Try running the command with elevated privileges if needed
Verify the file/directory permissions on the device
Restart ADB server and reconnect to the device

device_not_found.title: Device Not Found
device_not_found.description: No Android TV device detected or device is offline
solutions: Connect to the device using its IP address first
Check if the device is powered on and connected to network
Verify USB debugging is enabled in Developer Options
Accept the ADB authorization prompt on your TV screen
Try using the network scanner to find your device IP

adb_not_found.title: ADB Not Found
adb_not_found.description: Android Debug Bridge (ADB) is not installed on your system
solutions: Install ADB using your package manager (the tool can do this for you)
Verify ADB is in your system PATH
Restart your terminal after installation
Check if android-tools or android-sdk-platform-tools package is installed

timeout.title: Operation Timed Out
timeout.description: The operation took too long and was cancelled
solutions: Check your network connection stability
Try the operation again with a longer timeout
Verify the device is responsive and not frozen
Check if the device has sufficient resources (RAM/CPU)
Try restarting the device and reconnecting

file_not_found.pattern: (file not found|no such file|cannot find|does not exist)
file_not_found.title: File Not Found
file_not_found.description: The specified file or directory does not exist
solutions: Verify the file path is correct and the file exists
Check for typos in the file name or path
Ensure you have the correct permissions to access the file
Use absolute paths instead of relative paths
Check if the file was moved or deleted

insufficient_storage.title: Insufficient Storage
insufficient_storage.description: Not enough storage space available on the device
solutions: Clear application cache to free up space
Uninstall unused applications
Delete unnecessary files or media
Move apps to external storage if supported
Use the storage management feature to identify large files

package_not_found.title: Package Not Found
package_not_found.description: The specified application package is not installed
solutions: Verify the package name is correct (check for typos)
List installed packages to find the correct package name
Install the application first before trying to manage it
Check if the package was recently uninstalled
Use the package search feature to find the correct name

network_error.title: Network Error
solutions: Check your internet connection
Verify both PC and device are on the same network
Check router/firewall settings
Try disabling VPN if active
Restart your router and reconnect devices

download_failed.title: Download Failed
download_failed.description: Failed to download the requested file
solutions: Check your internet connection
Verify the download URL is still valid
Try downloading from an alternative source
Check if you have write permissions in the download directory
Disable any download managers or proxies that might interfere

invalid_apk.title: Invalid APK File
invalid_apk.description: The APK file is corrupted or invalid
solutions: Re-download the APK file from a trusted source
Verify the file downloaded completely (check file size)
Check if the APK is compatible with Android TV
Scan the APK for malware before installation
Try downloading from the official source

signature_mismatch.title: Signature Mismatch
signature_mismatch.description: APK signature does not match the installed version
solutions: Uninstall the existing version completely before installing
Use the same signing key if you're a developer
Download the APK from the same source as the original
Clear app data before uninstalling if the issue persists
Check if the app is a system app (may require special handling)

dependency_missing.title: Missing Dependency
dependency_missing.description: A required software dependency is not installed
solutions: Install the missing dependency using your package manager
The tool can automatically install dependencies for you
Check the documentation for manual installation steps
Verify your distribution is supported
Update your package manager cache and try again

unauthorized.title: Unauthorized Access
unauthorized.description: Device has not authorized this computer for ADB access
solutions: Check your TV screen for an authorization prompt
Accept the 'Allow USB debugging' prompt on the device
Try disconnecting and reconnecting to trigger the prompt
Clear ADB keys on the device and reconnect
Ensure 'USB debugging' is enabled in Developer Options

generic_error.title: Error Occurred
solutions: Check the error message for specific details
Try the operation again
Restart ADB server and reconnect to the device
Check the logs for more detailed error information
Search online for the specific error message
